name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static site content, TLS certificates, security configuration, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, runtime and log directory handling, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI application from GitHub, creates its virtual environment and database, and runs it through systemd on port 8000.
